title: Bear necessities: Indian techie builds wildlife alert
title_zh: 印度工程师开发野生动物预警系统
summary_zh: 为减少人与野生动物冲突，一位印度软件工程师开发了在线预警系统，旨在帮助喜马拉雅山区的居民避开危险的野生动物活动区域。
snippet: After his mother was killed in a bear attack in Kashmir, Indian software engineer Mudasir Ali developed an online early-warning system to help people in the Himalayan region avoid dangerous encounters with wildlife.

title: APOD: 2026 November 6 – A Farewell to Swift
title_zh: 每日天文一图：告别斯威夫特卫星
summary_zh: 这是每日天文一图（APOD）对斯威夫特卫星（Swift）的致敬，纪念这台在宇宙高能物理探测领域做出重要贡献的空间观测站。

Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. A Farewell […]

title: Taking a Gander at Utah’s Goosenecks
title_zh: 俯瞰犹他州的鹅颈湾曲流
summary_zh: 圣胡安河在沙漠地貌中雕琢出了深邃且极为弯曲的河道，为地质景观研究提供了壮观的样本。
snippet: The San Juan River has carved deep, improbably curvy meanders into the desert landscape.

title: Investigation links Australian deforestation to beef farming and major bank loans
title_zh: 澳大利亚森林砍伐与牛肉生产及银行贷款的关联调查
summary_zh: 调查显示澳大利亚的森林砍伐问题与牛肉工业及大规模银行贷款密切相关，呼吁关注经济活动对环境的破坏。
snippet: ACF's latest report, "Bulldozers and Broken Promises," an investigation into deforestation, has ruffled a few feathers. But someone has to do it. Why? Because deforestation is a huge problem in Australia.

title: Adaptation isn't keeping up with global warming, UN warns
title_zh: 联合国警告：全球变暖下的适应能力滞后
summary_zh: 联合国环境规划署（UNEP）报告指出，随着全球升温超过1.5°C，资金投入不足和制度壁垒导致应对气候变化的适应措施进展缓慢。
snippet: With global warming set to exceed 1.5°C, adaptation finance falls far short of needs, implementation is constrained by institutional barriers, and losses and damages are mounting, according to a new report from the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).

title: New species of sawfly described
title_zh: 科罗拉多州发现锯蝇新物种化石
summary_zh: 研究人员在科罗拉多州拥有5000万年历史的绿河组（Green River Formation）地层中，鉴定出了一种新的锯蝇（sawfly）物种。
snippet: Yale College junior Leah Mock did fieldwork in a remote quarry in western Colorado that exposes the 50-million-year-old Green River Formation.

title: How mitochondria keep protein production moving
title_zh: 线粒体如何维持蛋白质的顺利合成
summary_zh: 研究发现一种名为TACO1的蛋白质能帮助线粒体克服合成过程中的序列难题，这一机制的发现为理解相关线粒体疾病提供了线索。
snippet: Researchers at Karolinska Institutet have discovered how a protein called TACO1 helps mitochondria produce proteins when the process encounters difficult sequences. The study, published in Nature Communications, provides new insights into a mechanism that is disrupted in some mitochondrial diseases.

title: Research seeks to clarify assisted suicide practices in Germany and inform future regulation
title_zh: 德国协助自杀实践的研究与监管现状
summary_zh: 研究人员正通过科学数据整理德国协助自杀的实际案例，旨在为未来完善相关法律法规提供客观依据。
snippet: Assisted suicide is morally and ethically controversial. Public debate on the topic tends to arise primarily when a high-profile case comes to light—as was most recently the case with the famous twins Alice and Ellen Kessler. While assisted suicide is permitted in Germany, it is scarcely regulated by law. Until now, there has been little scientifically validated data on the current practice of assisted suicide.

title: Can engineering solve the forever chemical problem?
title_zh: 工程学能解决“永久性化学物质”问题吗？
summary_zh: 科学家正探索利用环糊精聚合物等新技术手段，应对环境中的“永久性化学物质”（PFAS）污染挑战。
snippet: Among the technical inquiries spanning topics like cyclodextrin polymers and mass spectrometry that were stacked in Damian Helbling's inbox was a question about four golden retrievers.

title: Hidden ecological risk from overlooked invasive crayfish species
title_zh: 被忽视的入侵物种：窄螯螯虾的生态风险
summary_zh: 一项研究揭示，在英国被忽视的窄螯螯虾（narrow-clawed crayfish）具有极强的侵略性，其生态风险堪比知名的入侵品种信号螯虾。
snippet: A new study reveals narrow-clawed crayfish, an understudied invasive species in the U.K., to be as aggressive as the well-known signal crayfish.

title: Successful restoration of fish migration requires more than fish passes
title_zh: 鱼道建设不足以完全恢复鱼类洄游
summary_zh: 研究指出，仅建设鱼道（fish passes）不足以实现有效的生态修复，科学的河流维护和水资源管理同样至关重要。
snippet: The Netherlands is constructing fish passes to make rivers and streams accessible to fish again. But how effective are these structures? New Ph.D. research by Panos Panagiotopoulos of Wageningen University shows that successful fish migration requires more than making individual barriers passable. Maintenance and water management are also crucial.

title: Soccer: Opaque club ownership is more likely associated with higher financial and criminal risks
title_zh: 足球俱乐部不透明所有权与金融犯罪风险的关联
summary_zh: 通过分析意大利足球俱乐部的股权结构，研究指出复杂的跨国所有权结构往往与更高的金融风险及犯罪活动关联度更高。
snippet: Who are the ultimate owners of Italian soccer clubs? Where does the money invested in these clubs come from? And what risks lie behind investment funds, fiduciary companies and transnational corporate structures that make it difficult to identify the individuals who ultimately control them?

title: Software squeezes more data out of Webb Telescope for imaging exoplanets
title_zh: 新型软件助力韦布空间望远镜提升系外行星成像能力
summary_zh: 通过优化韦布空间望远镜（Webb Telescope）的物理模型，新开发的处理软件能有效减少干扰噪声，从而从观测数据中提取更多行星图像细节。
snippet: Software optimizes a physical model of the telescope to reduce noise.

title: Goodbye, eggshell: How pregnancy emerged in the animal world
title_zh: 告别蛋壳：动物如何演化出胎生
summary_zh: 哺乳动物只经历过一次胎生演化，而蜥蜴和蛇却多次演化出这种特征。科学家正在探索这一深刻演变背后的生理机制和演化驱动因素。
snippet: Mammals evolved live birth just once; lizards and snakes did it over and over. What set the stage for this drastic change and how was it orchestrated?

title: As Antarctic blue whales advance along the road to recovery, continued oversight is key
title_zh: 南极蓝鲸种群数量显著回升
summary_zh: 经过50年的保护，南极蓝鲸种群数量从1973年捕鲸停止后的418头增长至约4018头，研究强调持续监管对物种恢复至关重要。
explain_zh: 研究发现，在长达50年的捕鲸禁令保护下，南极蓝鲸（Antarctic blue whale）种群数量正缓慢回升，目前估计约为4018头。研究者通过整合历史捕鲸数据、现有的样线调查（line transect survey）计数以及光线识别等多源数据，构建模型推算出这一结果。尽管种群处于恢复期，但数量仍远低于捕鲸前的水平，且其作为“生态系统工程师（ecosystem engineers）”在碳封存和养分循环中的作用尚需进一步监测以应对未来环境挑战。
snippet: Antarctic blue whales appear to be creeping back from the brink of extinction after 50 years of protection. A new study estimates the total population at 4,018, up from 418 after the last reported whale catch in 1973.

title: How octopuses squeeze through tiny openings, step by step
title_zh: 章鱼如何穿过狭小孔洞
summary_zh: 研究人员分析了章鱼穿过细小孔洞时的动作序列，这些发现可能为软体机器人（soft robots）的形态设计提供灵感。
explain_zh: 研究揭示了章鱼通过狭窄孔洞的挤压策略，并发现其逃生方案因孔洞大小而异。研究者观察了普通章鱼（Octopus vulgaris）和玛雅章鱼（Octopus maya）在不同尺寸亚克力箱中的行为，通过测量其头骨周围最坚硬的软骨结构尺寸，评估其通过能力。该研究不仅明确了章鱼逃生的步骤，还为软体机器人设计提供了灵感，即如何通过改变形态适应复杂环境。
snippet: In the lab, octopuses used specific moves to slip arms and a bulbous body through tiny holes. The finding could inspire new body plans for soft robots.

title: How octopuses squeeze through too-small gaps
title_zh: 章鱼如何穿过极其狭窄的缝隙
summary_zh: 章鱼凭借身体的极高柔韧性，能通过改变形体像液体一样流过狭小缝隙，从而克服体型大小对其栖息范围的限制。
snippet: Octopuses are extraordinarily versatile. From walking across the seabed on their eight arms to jetting through the water, manipulating tools and squeezing through unimaginably tight spaces, the flexibility of octopuses almost defies belief. "Octopuses can change their body shape to squeeze through tiny holes, almost like water flowing through a gap, so their size doesn't always limit where they can go," says Wenci Xin from the National University of Singapore.

title: Born to be queen: A look inside fire ant hierarchy
title_zh: 火蚁等级制度的遗传机制
summary_zh: 研究发现，一组特定的基因可能为火蚁个体提供优势，使其更有机会生长发育成为蜂后级别的个体。
snippet: A group of genes may give some fire ants an advantage, increasing their chances of growing larger and potentially becoming queens, according to a new study from the University of Georgia.

title: How private schools segregate students by class and strengthen social divisions
title_zh: 私立学校如何加剧阶级隔离
summary_zh: 本文以伦敦Southwark区为例，分析了私立学校如何通过社会阶层筛选，进一步固化社会分化和不平等。
snippet: If you want to see how private schools in the U.K. can reinforce segregation between children of different social classes, the London Borough of Southwark provides a good example.

title: Avian influenza spread beyond a backyard coop on an Illinois farm, analysis finds
title_zh: 高致病性禽流感在农场跨物种传播
summary_zh: 一项分析显示，伊利诺伊州农场暴发的禽流感不仅影响了家禽，还传染给了农场里的家猫和野生老鼠，预警了病原体的跨物种风险。
snippet: An outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza virus that nearly wiped out an Illinois farmer's backyard flock also spread to a domestic cat and wild rats on the farm, an analysis of the animals by the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory and the University of Missouri Veterinary Medical Diagnostic Laboratory found.

title: Newly identified protein mechanism helps explain how cells respond to physical forces
title_zh: Talin蛋白力学感知机制新发现
summary_zh: 研究发现了一种新的力学调控机制，即关键蛋白Talin如何响应外界机械力变化，从而调节细胞的粘附与力学感知。
snippet: A newly published study is changing our understanding of how the protein talin functions at sites where cells attach to their surroundings. The findings uncover a previously unknown mechanism by which mechanical force regulates talin, a key protein controlling cell adhesion and mechanosensing. The paper is published in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.

title: Clothes on the bed, nothing feels right: The psychology behind your seasonal wardrobe meltdown
title_zh: 季节性更替引发的心理与穿搭烦恼
summary_zh: 心理学分析探讨了为何季节变化时，我们面对衣橱会产生认知偏差和心理不适，这是环境改变引起心理适应压力的表现。
snippet: The clocks have gone back, and suddenly getting dressed feels more difficult. The coat you wore constantly last winter is still hanging in the closet, but it no longer looks quite how you remember. The boots you loved in February don't seem to go with anything, while a sweater that once felt like you somehow doesn't anymore.

title: New microscopy method reveals tiny cell structures and their molecular surroundings
title_zh: 新型显微成像技术可视化细胞超微结构
summary_zh: 研究人员开发了一种能在观测微小细胞结构的同时，实时分析其分子环境变化的新型显微镜技术，有助于提升对药物作用机制的研究精度。
snippet: How do cells respond to drugs? A new microscopy technique could provide more precise answers to this question in the future. Researchers from Bielefeld University and the University of Vienna have developed a method as part of the European CHEM-SCAN project that makes the smallest cellular structures visible while also showing how their molecular environment changes.

title: Hubble learns galactic history from stars
title_zh: 哈勃望远镜揭示Messier 30球状星团历史
summary_zh: 通过哈勃望远镜拍摄的影像，天文学家得以观测距离27500光年外的Messier 30星团，揭示了该星团内部恒星演化的历史片段。
snippet: This NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image provides a lesson in galactic history. The sparkling collection of stars is named Messier 30 (M30) after the French astronomer Charles Messier, who cataloged M30 and other diffuse objects that might be mistaken for comets in the early telescopes of Messier's time. M30 lies about 27,500 light-years away in the constellation Capricornus.

title: Linguist to record the magic songs of the Awajún people of Peru
title_zh: 秘鲁Awajún族“魔法之歌”的语言学记录
summary_zh: 语言学家正在记录秘鲁亚马逊地区Awajún原住民的传统歌谣，旨在研究这些特殊文化载体背后蕴含的文化与语言魅力。
snippet: There is magic in the traditional songs of the Awajún, an Indigenous people of northern Peruvian Amazonia. Otago linguist Dr. Simon Overall has been visiting this area for over 20 years and explains what gives these songs their powers.

title: Record-low temperature created on China’s space station
title_zh: 中国空间站创造超低温纪录
summary_zh: 利用微重力环境，中国空间站内的原子冷却至约10万亿分之一开尔文，达到极低温度水平。
explain_zh: 科学家在中国天宫空间站上利用激光陷阱捕获并冷却了2万个铷原子，成功创造了约10皮开尔文（picokelvin）的极低温纪录。研究者利用微重力环境减少引力对原子云的影响，使其形成玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（Bose-Einstein condensate），这是一种原子达到统一量子态的特殊物质形式。该实验不仅刷新了温度纪录，还为研究奇异物质态、基础物理概念（如等效原理）提供了理想平台。
snippet: With gravity's effects mitigated, atoms orbiting Earth on China’s space station reached about 10 trillionths of a kelvin.

title: Statehouse wins give Democrats new power to push clean energy
title_zh: 美国州议会能源政策走向
summary_zh: 美国民主党在州议会取得的新进展，或将改变该地区推行清洁能源政策的能力。
snippet: Democrats erased the GOP’s trifecta edge and gained new power over energy policy.

title: Midwestern City Lights
title_zh: 从空间站俯瞰美国城市夜景
summary_zh: 国际空间站拍摄的照片记录了黎明前美国东部及中西部地区城市灯火辉煌的景观。
snippet: City lights from the Midwestern United States to the East Coast sparkle across the landscape a couple of hours before sunrise on Oct. 18, 2026. Major urban areas visible in the photograph include Chicago, Illinois; Detroit, Michigan; and the New York metropolitan region. The International Space Station was orbiting 259 miles above Earth when this […]

title: NASA Astronauts to Answer Questions from Florida Students
title_zh: 航天员与学生连线互动
summary_zh: 美国航天员将在国际空间站通过视频连线回答佛罗里达州学生提出的STEM问题。
snippet: Students in Florida will hear from NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney as they answer prerecorded STEM questions while aboard the International Space Station. The Earth-to-space call will begin at 10:40 a.m. EST Tuesday, Nov. 10, and will stream live on the agency’s Learn With NASA YouTube channel. This event is hosted by Freedom Crossing Academy in […]

title: Scientists discover that a clogged filter could revolutionize oil refining
title_zh: 新型膜技术有望革新石油精炼工艺
summary_zh: 科学家开发出一种利用原油自身建立微孔通道的膜材料，可在室温下进行分离，有望大幅降低精炼过程的能耗与碳排放。
explain_zh: 研究人员开发出一种基于多孔聚丙烯腈（PAN）膜的新型过滤系统，能在室温下高效分离原油，无需传统精炼过程中的高温蒸馏。该方法利用原油自身组分在膜孔中堆积，形成小于2纳米的通道，实现对油品组分的精确筛分。实验表明此膜可将炼油能耗降低约32%，碳排放减少约38%，并能显著降低运营成本，具有极高的工业应用前景。
snippet: Scientists have developed a remarkable new membrane that separates crude oil at room temperature, using the oil itself to create microscopic filtration channels. The breakthrough could cut refining energy consumption by nearly 32%, carbon emissions by almost 38%, and operating costs by 36%, potentially transforming one of the world's most energy-intensive industries.

title: 400,000-year-old teeth reveal a stunning twist in human evolution
title_zh: 40万年前的化石牙齿揭示人类演化新联系
summary_zh: 对中国发现的Homo erectus（直立人）牙齿进行蛋白提取研究发现，这一古人类可能与Denisovans（丹尼索瓦人）存在杂交，挑战了单一演化路径的认识。
explain_zh: 研究从中国出土的约40万年前直立人（Homo erectus）牙齿中提取了古蛋白质，发现了其与丹尼索瓦人（Denisovans）存在基因交换的证据。通过对比牙釉质蛋白质序列，研究者确认这些古人类拥有独特的氨基酸变体，且部分遗传特征可能传递至今，影响了现代东南亚及大洋洲人群。该发现表明人类进化并非单一的树状分支，而是复杂交织的河流，揭示了远古人种间存在频繁的基因交流。
snippet: A groundbreaking discovery is rewriting the story of human evolution, revealing that an ancient human species once thought to be an evolutionary dead end may have left genetic traces in people alive today. By extracting proteins from 400,000-year-old Homo erectus teeth discovered in China, scientists uncovered evidence suggesting that these early humans interbred with Denisovans, another mysterious ancient human group. title: Hubble Learns Galactic History From Stars
title_zh: 哈勃望远镜拍摄星团Messier 30
summary_zh: 哈勃空间望远镜（Hubble Space Telescope）拍摄的图像展示了球状星团Messier 30的璀璨星群。
snippet: This Hubble image features the sparkling collection of stars named Messier 30 (M30), also called NGC 7099.

title: Scientists discover mysterious “lonely” brain waves linked to memory loss
title_zh: 深睡期的异常脑电波与记忆衰退相关
summary_zh: 研究发现阿尔茨海默病相关蛋白积累会导致深睡期脑电波紊乱，这一微小的脑部功能改变可能是记忆衰退的早期指标。
snippet: Scientists have uncovered a surprising link between Alzheimer’s-related protein buildup, disrupted brain waves during deep sleep, and fading memory. The findings suggest that hidden changes in how the brain processes memories overnight may contribute to age-related memory loss long before Alzheimer’s symptoms appear.

title: Scientists solve 30-year-old mystery and discover a hidden defense against inflammation
title_zh: 揭示免疫系统抵御炎症损伤的隐藏机制
summary_zh: 科学家解决了长达30年的医学难题，发现了一项保护健康细胞免受炎症过度损伤的免疫机制，这有望为癌症和炎症性疾病治疗提供新思路。
snippet: Scientists have solved a decades-old mystery and uncovered a hidden immune system defense that protects healthy cells from the very inflammation meant to fight infections. The surprising discovery could lead to new approaches for treating cancer, inflammatory bowel disease, and other conditions involving excessive inflammation.

title: APOD: 2026 November 5 – Enceladus in Silhouette
title_zh: 土卫二的剪影图像
summary_zh: 每日天文图（APOD）展示了土星卫星土卫二（Enceladus）在背光下的轮廓影像。

Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Enceladus in Silhouette […]

title: Cyprus: Island of Snakes, Cats, and Ophiolites
title_zh: 地质与生物多样性共存的塞浦路斯
summary_zh: 地中海第三大岛塞浦路斯不仅暴露了古老的海底地层（蛇绿岩，ophiolites），还是猫科动物的聚居地。
snippet: The third-largest island in the Mediterranean Sea exposes an ancient piece of the ocean floor and hosts a clowder of cats.

title: Little Ice Age cooling in Europe may have raised the risk of rickets
title_zh: 小冰期可能增加了佝偻病风险
summary_zh: 历史研究表明，欧洲“小冰期”带来的环境变化及工业革命影响，可能导致了18、19世纪人群的维生素D缺乏。
snippet: The Industrial Revolution and climate change may have both contributed to vitamin D deficiencies in 18th and 19th century Europe.

title: Scientists turn viruses into weapons against deadly superbugs
title_zh: 噬菌体疗法助力对抗抗生素耐药性
summary_zh: 国际研究团队发布了噬菌体疗法（利用病毒杀死特定细菌）的临床指南，初步研究表明该疗法在处理难治性细菌感染中显示出良好潜力。
snippet: Scientists are advancing a promising new way to fight antibiotic-resistant infections by using viruses that specifically target and kill harmful bacteria. An international team has released the first coordinated guidelines for personalized phage therapy, offering a roadmap for safely bringing this experimental treatment into clinical practice. Early findings are encouraging, with one study reporting improvement in 77% of patients and the disappearance of targeted bacteria in 61%.

title: NASA Announces X-70 Experimental Aircraft to Advance Flight Research
title_zh: NASA发布X-70实验飞机
summary_zh: NASA推出的新款X-70实验机配备了可重构飞行控制技术，旨在加速先进航空技术的测试与开发。
snippet: On Wednesday, NASA unveiled its newest experimental aircraft, the X-70 Fractal, during the UP.Summit at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. This high-performance, highly adaptable research platform is designed to accelerate the development and testing of advanced aviation technologies. The crewed X-70 features advanced, rapidly reconfigurable flight-control technology that will allow NASA to explore […]

title: Uranium cubes reveal why the German nuclear project failed
title_zh: 铀块分析揭示德国核计划失败原因
summary_zh: 针对二战时期德国铀块的最新计算显示，海森堡（Heisenberg）当时严重低估了实现核连锁反应所需的材料量。
explain_zh: 历史研究证实，二战期间纳粹德国的核计划之所以失败，核心原因是其反应堆设计方案存在重大缺陷，且缺乏足够的铀和重水。研究者通过分析幸存的铀立方体并结合历史文档计算发现，海森堡（Werner Heisenberg）严重低估了实现核临界所需的材料量，且受限于战时资源匮乏和技术杂质，德国的石墨堆技术难以达到临界点。此研究驳斥了关于纳粹德国仅差一点即可造出原子弹的猜测。
snippet: "Our calculations suggest Heisenberg significantly underestimated the materials required."

title: NASA Shares Plans to Accelerate Artemis, Return to Moon
title_zh: NASA公布重返月球计划更新
summary_zh: NASA确认了Artemis项目的进度安排，计划在2028年实现人类重返月球表面。
explain_zh: NASA宣布加速阿尔忒弥斯（Artemis）载人登月计划，目标提前至2028年实现月面着陆，并将于2027年执行Artemis III测试任务。该任务将通过太空发射系统（SLS）发射猎户座（Orion）飞船，在地球轨道测试与SpaceX和Blue Origin登月舱的对接技术，以降低未来深空任务的风险。NASA通过精简硬件流程和自主研发关键组件，旨在以更高效、低成本的方式建立持续的月球存在。
snippet: In an update on Oct. 23, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman and other agency leaders shared the agency’s path to returning Americans to the lunar surface in 2028. Agency leadership provided updates on the previously announced acceleration plans for the Artemis program, advancing toward the agency’s Artemis III test flight in 2027 and Artemis IV Moon […]

title: NASA Announces Ka-Band Satellite Relay Awards for Space Communications
title_zh: NASA布局Ka波段卫星通信中继能力
summary_zh: NASA选中三家公司开发兼容现有航天任务的Ka波段空间中继方案，旨在无需改装航天器的情况下，通过端到端解决方案确保空间通信服务的连续性。
snippet: NASA selected three companies on Wednesday to perform work to develop Ka-band space relay capability concepts that are compatible with current missions in space, ensuring service continuity for existing spacecraft without requiring modifications to their onboard systems. Through this work, NASA will aim to acquire end-to-end solutions that include space, ground, launch, operations, and integration […]

title: NASA Navigation Experiment Shows Promise for Planetary Landings
title_zh: NASA展示行星着陆自主导航技术
summary_zh: NASA成功测试了名为SPLICE的导航与控制载荷，该技术能辅助航天器在月球或其他行星表面寻找安全着陆点，实现自主降落。
snippet: NASA successfully demonstrated technology designed to help spacecraft autonomously navigate to safe landing sites on the Moon and on other planets. An Alta-X drone equipped with the agency’s Safe and Precise Landing – Integrated Capabilities Evolution (SPLICE) guidance, navigation, and control payload completed simulated lunar descent and landing maneuvers Aug. 27. The flight took place […]

title: NASA Space Grant Students Fuel Agency’s Inspiration Tour
title_zh: NASA通过空间资助计划激励青年参与航天
summary_zh: NASA的“灵感之旅”活动通过连接公众、学术界与行业专家，展示航天创新成果，并借此鼓励学生积极投身航天事业。
snippet: NASA’s Inspiration Tour spread the excitement of space exploration and aeronautical innovation by connecting the public, industry, and academia with the people, technologies, and organizations that drive American leadership in space. At nearly every stop across the country, NASA Space Grant has brought students into the heart of the action. In Iowa, NASA Administrator Jared […]

title: New Research Tests Whether AI Models Know Their Own Thoughts
title_zh: AI模型是否具备“自我意识”
summary_zh: 研究人员通过向大语言模型（LLM）植入特定“想法”，探索AI是否存在内省能力。
explain_zh: 研究者通过在大型语言模型（LLM）内部植入特定的激活模式（类似“植入想法”），测试其是否具备自我反思（introspection）的能力。实验显示，模型有时能准确报告并描述被植入的概念，且控制组未出现误报。虽然研究暂不涉及意识问题，但这种实证方法为评估AI是否能够察觉并描述其自身内部状态提供了重要途径。
snippet: By injecting “thoughts” directly into large language models, researchers are trying to map out AI’s capacity for introspection. The post New Research Tests Whether AI Models Know Their Own Thoughts first appeared on Quanta Magazine

title: Earwax’s surprisingly slippery but sticky properties deters insects
title_zh: 耳垢的物理特性可抵御昆虫
summary_zh: 研究发现耳垢兼具黏性和润滑性，这种独特的物理属性有助于防止昆虫误入耳道。
snippet: A comprehensive study of earwax reveals a combination of slippery and sticky properties that may protect against insect invasions of the ear.

title: Scientists may have finally explained why our brains and bodies are cross-wired
title_zh: 人类脑部结构“交叉布线”的进化起源
summary_zh: 研究推测，大脑左右半球分别控制对侧肢体的“交叉布线”结构，可能起源于5亿多年前原始鱼类的视觉系统进化留下的遗迹。
snippet: Scientists propose that the brain’s mysterious cross-wiring, which connects each hemisphere to the opposite side of the body, may have originated more than 500 million years ago in the visual systems of ancient fish. Rather than evolving for a specific advantage, this unusual arrangement may simply be a legacy of evolution building new brain circuits on an ancient foundation.

title: Permanent daylight saving time has a dark side, scientists warn
title_zh: 研究警示永久夏令时的潜在危害
summary_zh: 研究指出，若推行永久夏令时，由于早晨上学时间处于黑暗中，可能使美国学童面临更大的交通事故风险，并干扰其生物钟。
snippet: A new study warns that permanent daylight saving time could force American children to make at least 2 billion additional school commutes in darkness, potentially increasing safety risks and disrupting their biological clocks. Researchers found that fatal crashes involving school-aged pedestrians were roughly twice as likely during dark mornings as after sunrise.

title: A tiny squeeze dramatically changes the magnetism of exotic materials
title_zh: 机械挤压改变交错磁体磁性
summary_zh: 科学家发现，通过简单的机械挤压即可显著改变“交错磁体”（altermagnets，一类具有特殊磁性和电学特性的新型材料）的行为，这一发现有望为研发更高效的电子设备和量子计算技术提供新路径。
snippet: Scientists have discovered that a simple mechanical squeeze can dramatically alter the magnetic properties and electrical behavior of exotic materials called altermagnets. The surprising breakthrough could open the door to faster, more energy-efficient electronics and new technologies for quantum computing.

title: MIT scientists break a 20-year rule and unlock never-before-seen crystal structures
title_zh: MIT打破晶体排列定论，解锁新型结构
summary_zh: MIT研究团队发现，利用柔性分子连接方式而非传统的刚性连接，可以实现纳米颗粒的全新排列组合。这一突破挑战了过去20年的主流认知，为设计具备特殊功能的定制材料开辟了新方向。
snippet: MIT scientists have challenged two decades of conventional thinking by discovering that flexible molecular connections, rather than rigid ones, can unlock entirely new ways to arrange nanoparticles. The breakthrough could lead to a new generation of designer materials with unusual properties and applications in electronics, medicine, and energy.

title: Food contains thousands of overlooked chemicals. This physicist is mapping them
title_zh: 绘制食物中的复杂化学物质
summary_zh: 研究人员正在通过物理学方法绘制食物中被忽视的数千种化学物质，以探索其对微生物群和人类健康的影响。
snippet: Giulia Menichetti is exploring how food’s vast chemical complexity may shape the microbiome and human health.

title: NASA is racing against time to save the Hubble Space Telescope
title_zh: NASA寻求方案延长Hubble太空望远镜寿命
summary_zh: 由于轨道高度逐渐降低，Hubble太空望远镜面临重返大气层损毁的风险。NASA目前正寻求私营航天公司的技术方案，旨在通过提升轨道或升级维护，延续这一传奇观测站的科学使命。
snippet: NASA is exploring a daring plan to save the legendary Hubble Space Telescope from its eventual fiery plunge into Earth's atmosphere. After more than 35 years of groundbreaking discoveries, Hubble is slowly losing altitude, and without intervention, it could fall back to Earth as early as 2033 or 2034. title: How hawkmoths turned their genitals into bat-busting weapons
title_zh: 天蛾演化出生殖器超声波防御
summary_zh: 在与蝙蝠的演化博弈中，天蛾演化出了三种利用生殖器发出超声波干扰蝙蝠回声定位的防御机制。
snippet: In arms race with bats, hawkmoths have evolved three distinct ways to make bat-busting ultrasound using their genitalia.

title: Your voice can now say things you never said
title_zh: 合成语音技术的伦理挑战
summary_zh: 合成语音技术虽能辅助失语者，但也引发了关于诈骗、个人同意权及数字人格存续的伦理考量。
snippet: Synthetic voices can restore speech, enable scams and outlive their owners. These uses raise questions about trust, consent and control.

title: A drug-free diabetes treatment? An implant lowers blood sugar in mice
title_zh: 无线植入物在小鼠实验中降低血糖
summary_zh: 一款无线植入装置在小鼠模型中能按需降低血糖并促进减重，为未来糖尿病和肥胖症治疗提供了新思路。
snippet: The wireless implant rids mice's bodies of excess sugar on demand, and helps them shed weight. It could one day help treat diabetes and obesity.

title: The migration that remade Africa
title_zh: 班图人迁徙如何改变非洲
summary_zh: 6000至4000年前的班图语族（Bantu-speaking people）大规模迁徙，彻底重塑了非洲的文化、语言和遗传格局。
snippet: Between 6,000 and 4,000 years ago, a group known as the Bantu-speaking people began to migrate across Africa, transforming the continent’s cultures, languages and genetic makeup

title: Why large dogs age faster than small ones, and other October research highlights
title_zh: 大型犬衰老速度研究
summary_zh: 近期科研要点包括大型犬为何衰老更快、隐形纹身技术及捕获单个反物质粒子等研究成果。
snippet: Plus invisible tattoos, medieval skeleton gets an ID, trapping a single antimatter particle, and more.
